title: Geonomics Readout Extraction Dry Run & Adjudication Input Validation
scope: two consecutive canonical states per job, all four frozen seeds
integrity_rules: Model.get_coords must exactly match canonical x,y
Species._cells must exactly equal floor(canonical x,y)
Layer.rast must exactly match canonical native-layer target
integrity mismatch is adapter/runtime failure, never scientific divergence
descriptive_rules: layer summaries preserve exact source raster digest
all descriptive metrics have no numeric acceptance threshold
descriptive values cannot automatically PASS or FAIL ARCANA
adjudication_input_rules: every metric id must be pre-authorized for that job by R4.43
all R4.43 common record fields must be present
nonclaim: R4.44 validates extraction and adjudication-input mechanics only; dry-run outputs are not scientific evidence
